about.title: About Me
about.p1: IT technician specialized in frontend development with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. My goal is simple: save you time. I specialize in building structured, clean, and optimized websites and web applications so your business runs without complications. I believe in organized code, on-time deliveries, and solutions that truly make your project grow. 🛠️ Do you have an idea or need to optimize your web presence? Let's talk and make it happen.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of my work and open source projects

p1.title: Game Learning
p1.description: Interactive platform for learning JavaScript through level-based lessons, exercises, and assessments. Built with Astro, Vue, and TypeScript, it includes responsive design, keyboard navigation, and Vitest and Playwright tests.
p1.preview_alt: Game Learning preview, a platform for learning JavaScript

p2.title: REST Countries — Where in the world?
p2.description: Application for exploring, searching, and filtering countries by region, with detail pages and light/dark mode. Built with Svelte and TypeScript, it integrates a REST API and applies data validation, caching, and tests.
p2.preview_alt: REST Countries preview, a country search app with regional filters

p3.title: Todo App
p3.description: Task application with filtering, editing, deletion, light/dark mode, and reordering. Built with React and TypeScript, it demonstrates interactive interface development.
p3.preview_alt: Todo App preview, a task manager with filters and light and dark themes
